grammar.title: Can & Be able to
lines: can/could 情态动词 Can / Could I borrow you pen?表示请求别人允许或答复时的情况
can/could 表推测 I can have lunch with your tomorrow if you like.可以表示可能性

can/could 天生的或学到的能力 I could drive a car by the time I was sixteen.过去时 I tried again and found I could / was able to swim .过去时 Can Jane swim yet?现在时 No, but she’ll be able to swim in a few months’ time. 表示将来的“能力”时，则用 will be able to
正在发生的事时 Look! I can stand on my head.

表示成功地完成某一具体动作时 It’s pity he couldn’t visit Mary. 如果表示某一动作没有取得成功，则可用 couldn’t Oh, didn’t you know? He was able to visit her after all. 通常不用 could，而用 be able to He was able to leave Europe before the war began. 他在战争开始之前得以离开欧洲。 He was able to go to London yesterday and he enjoyed himself very much.
过去某一具体活动时 Could he borrow a car? 可用 could Yes, he was able to borrow a car after all./No, he couldn’t. 但回答是肯定的时候则不能

sentences.title: 含有介词 at 的词组
lines: 表示时间 at first（开始时，最初） At first Byrd and his men were able to take a great many photographs.
at once（马上，立刻） Byrd at once ordered his men to throw out two heavy food sack.
at present（目前，现在） At any rate, I’m determined to stay here at present.
at last（最后，终于） After walking for several hours, we arrived at the village at last.
at times（有时、偶尔） He behaves very strange at times.
at the moment （现在） At the moment, he's in Madrid.
表示地点 at home（在家） Billy is not at home at present.
at school（在学校） He's at school.
表示程度 at least（至少） At least, I’m not mad yet.
at any rate（不管怎样） It's a pity you can't come to the concert. At any rate you' Il be able to hear it on the radio.
其它 at heart（内心里，实际上） Though he tried to made conversation with the lady, he wasn’t interested in her at heart.
at a loss（困惑不解，不知怎么办） Why? I’m at a loss.I don't know what I can do about it. I' m completely at a loss.
